label: clear-article
text: Could you pass me pencil on the table?

result.summary: 请求对方把桌上的铅笔递给自己。

label: unclear-people
text: Rosa called Emma after she had sold her car.

result.summary: Rosa在卖掉车之后给Emma打了电话，但不清楚是谁卖的车。

issues.original: after she had sold her car
issues.improved: after Rosa had sold her car
issues.explanation: she和her可能指Rosa或Emma，无法确定是谁卖了车。如果你想表达Rosa卖了自己的车，可明确用Rosa；若指Emma，应使用Emma。

label: conflict-return
text: I will come back two days ago.

result.summary: 说话者提到回来，但将来表达与两天前的时间冲突，不能确定何时回来。

issues.original: I will come back two days ago.
issues.improved: I came back two days ago.
issues.explanation: will指向将来，two days ago指向过去，回来的时间无法确定。如果你想表达两天前已经回来了，可用此句；若想表达将来，应改时间而非假定过去。

label: contextual-transfer
text: Can you borrow me your umbrella? I will return it tonight.

result.summary: 说话者请求借用对方的雨伞，并承诺今晚归还。

alternatives.explanation: 原话意思已清楚；lend是标准用法，表示对方把东西借给你。

label: clear-minor-past
text: Yesterday I walk to work because the bus was late.

result.summary: 昨天因为公交车晚点，说话者步行去上班。

label: two-problems
text: I arrived next month. I borrow you my bicycle.

result.summary: 说话者提到到达，但过去时态与下个月的时间冲突，不能确定何时到达。说话者把自己的自行车借给对方。

issues.explanation: arrived指向过去，next month指向将来，到达的时间无法确定。如果你想表达下个月到达，可用此句；若想表达过去，应改时间而非假定将来。
